subject: GCP private offer - commit prioritization & burn swap
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <procurement@aurora.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudreseller.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: restructure GCP private offer commit for Q3 consumption

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the earlier walkthrough. We have an approved PO for the private offer (attached: Aurora_PO_8473.pdf) but our Q3 usage profile shifted materially — we expect heavy burst consumption in July and early August, then a long tail through Q4. The current drawdown schedule that was provisioned front-loads credits into Sep, which will create a gap in July.

Can Redwood help:
- re-prioritize the commit drawdown so ~55% of the committed credits are available July 1–Aug 15 and the remainder over Sep–Dec
- provide a proposed invoice cadence and any implications for co-sell split with CloudReseller

We can sign an amendment / updated private offer if needed. CC'ing our contracts and your reseller partner.

Appreciate a quick path — need to finalize internal budget cadence by Wednesday.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Cloud Ops, Aurora Analytics
attachments: Aurora_PO_8473.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <procurement@aurora.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, contracts@cloudreseller.com
Date: 2026-06-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: restructure GCP private offer commit for Q3 consumption

Lena — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. We can support a front-loaded drawdown but need to align on two things quickly: 1) how much of the committed SKU pool we can swap forward without violating the vendor amortization rules, and 2) the invoice schedule your procurement team prefers.

Immediate next steps (we can do these today):
- I will run a quick SKU-level compatibility check with GCP (looping in Ben and Marissa).
- Aditya will surface implications for co-sell crediting and reseller split.
- Please confirm which legal signatory will OK an amendment (DocuSign link preferred).

If you can share a target dollar split for July vs Sep–Dec that helps. I’ll aim to get a working proposal back within 36 hours.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: restructure GCP private offer commit for Q3 consumption

Kimberly / team — quick internal coordination. Summary of constraints/observations after a first pass with GCP:
- GCP allows re-phasing of private offer drawdown but requires alignment on SKU mapping and an amended redemption schedule.
- We can shift up to ~60% of the committed USD into earlier invoice periods if Aurora consents to front-loaded redemption and we push invoices earlier (finance has to accept).
- Co-sell/reseller splits: Aditya — will the channel team accept a modified revenue recognition window if we materially change invoice dates? My assumption: yes with a memo.

Proposed plan (actionable):
1) Run an SKU burn simulation for Aurora's usage profile (Ben) — deliverable: new drawdown curve CSV and expected token/burn distribution.
2) Draft amendment language for the private offer and bill timing (Lauren) — deliverable: redline for DocuSign.
3) Aditya to confirm co-sell crediting and any marketing rebate impacts.

Timelines: Ben and Lauren can have drafts by EOD tomorrow. I’ll compile for Kimberly to send to Aurora with attachments.

Questions:
- Kimberly: do we want to propose a 55/45 split as Lena suggested or present 3 options (conservative / balanced / aggressive)?

--Marissa
From: Lena Ortiz <procurement@aurora.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudreseller.com
Date: 2026-06-22T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: restructure GCP private offer commit for Q3 consumption

Kimberly / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the plan. We discussed internally and prefer a single clean amendment: target 55% July 1–Aug 15, 45% Sep 1–Dec 31. For invoicing, can Redwood issue two invoices: one for the July–Aug tranche (due on July 5) and a second for the remainder on Sep 1? If DocuSign is easiest, my CFO (Dan Park) will sign — copied him here (dan.park@aurora.ai).

Also: please include an invoice schedule spreadsheet showing dates, USD amounts, and GCP SKU mapping so our accounting team can reconcile.

Quoted for context: "I will run a quick SKU-level compatibility check with GCP (looping in Ben and Marissa)." — happy to wait for that output.

Lena
attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <procurement@aurora.ai>, Dan Park <dan.park@aurora.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, contracts@cloudreseller.com
Date: 2026-06-22T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: restructure GCP private offer commit for Q3 consumption

Dan / Lena — thanks, we can do the two-invoice cadence you requested. Attached is our proposed runbook and schedule (commit_reprioritization_runbook.pdf) and a line-item invoice schedule (invoice_schedule_proposal.xlsx). Key notes:

- SKU mapping: Ben validated the mapping against GCP SKUs and confirms the July tranche can be consumed under the same offer without creating overage risk, assuming Aurora uses the listed SKUs.
- Invoice dates: Invoice 1 (July tranche) issued July 1, net 4 (due July 5). Invoice 2 (remainder) issued Sep 1, net 30.
- Accounting effect: Aditya confirms co-sell crediting will follow the invoice recognition dates; channel partner split will be processed on the July invoice once CloudReseller confirms.
- DocuSign: Lauren has prepared an amendment redline; I'll send a DocuSign link after Aurora confirms signatory (Dan).

Action items:
- Dan: confirm signatory and I’ll route DocuSign today.
- Aurora: confirm the invoice P.O. number you want on each invoice (if different).
- CloudReseller: confirm the revenue split timing (contracts@cloudreseller.com).

Thanks all — attaching runbook and invoice schedule.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
